t: Din mi sheen lo matztza shemura
s: Din mi sheen lo matztza shemura ubo z' seipim: mi sheen lo matztza shemura mishsheat lisha vaelak ki im kezayit echad bilbad — lo yoklennu bitchillat hasseuda qodem akilat maror, ella yoklennu apiqoman achar gemar kol hasseuda, kede sheyyishshaer taam matztza bepiv, vibarek alayv "al akilat matztza". Ubitchillat hasseuda yebarek "hammotzi" bilbad al lechem mishneh shelemot mimmatztza sheenah shemura, veyokal mimmennu kezayit miyyad kede sheyyihyeh haqqiddush bimqom seuda kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"g, veachar kak yebarek "al akilat maror" veyokal mimmennu kezayit echad, veen tzarik od kezayit lekorko im matztza, kevan sheenah shemura eno yotze bah yede chobat kerika, veoto kezayit hashshamur i epshar lekorko im maror, shello yebattel mitzvat aseh shel akilat matztza min hattora, sheeno yotze yede chobat matztza baakilat kerika zo, lepi shemmatztza bizman hazzeh min hattora vehammaror hu middibre soperim umebattel hammaror et taam hammatztza, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h:

Abal im yesh lo kamma zetim mimmatztza shemura mishsheat lisha ella sheen lo matztza shemura mishsheat qetzira ki im kezayit echad bilbad — yanniach oto kezayit ben shette hashshelemot vibarek "hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza", veyokal oto kezayit im kezayit mehashshelema, veachar kak yebarek "al akilat maror" veyokal mimmennu kezayit echad, veachar kak yokal mimmennu kezayit sheni bikrika im matztza shemura mishsheat lisha, veachar gemar kol hasseuda yokal haapiqoman mimmatztza shemura mishsheat lisha. Veap shello yishshaer bepiv taam matztza shemura mishsheat qetzira, mikkol maqom kevan shemmeiqqar haddin day beshimmur mishsheat lisha — im ken mutab sheyyishshaer bepiv taam shemura mishsheat lisha, vehashshemura mishsheat qetzira yebarek aleha leteabon bitchillat hasseuda veyoklenna qodem akilat hammaror, mimmah sheyyoklenna shello leteabon achar gemar kol hasseuda belo beraka, veyitztarek lebarek "al akilat matztza" al matztza shemura mishsheat lisha qodem akilat hammaror, kede latzet yede chobat matztza qodem sheyyetze yede chobat maror, vegam kede leoklah leteabon, vegam kede liptor bibraka zo et hakkezayit matztza shemura mishsheat lisha sheyyokal bikrika im maror, dekevan sheyyesh lo matztza shemura mishsheat lisha shehi keshera meiqqar haddin, al ken chayyab hu leekol mimmenna leteabon qodem akilat hammaror, velaasot mimmenna kerika, vechayyab gam ken lebarek aleha meiqqar haddin:

(Mi sheen lo matztza kelal apillu sheenah shemura ki im kezayit echad bilbad shamur mishsheat lisha o mishsheat qetzira, veken) choleh sheeno yakol leekol matztza ki im kezayit echad bilbad — yokal tabshilo ushear seudato belo netilat yadayim ve"hammotzi", veachar gemar seudato yittol yadayv belo beraka, vibarek "hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza" veyokal oto kezayit, kede sheyyishshaer taam matztza shemura bepiv, velo yitom achar kak kelum. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheqqiddesh al hayyayin, abal im en lo yayin velo shear mashqeh shehu chamar medina, vetzarik leqaddesh al happat kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tp"g, im ken mittechilla yokal oto kezayit veachar kak yokal tabshilo ushear seudato:

Mi sheen lo lishne hallelot raq shalosh matztzot bilbad shemurot mishsheat lisha o mishsheat qetzira — yebarek lel rishon "hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza" al happerusa shepparas mimmenna kebar kezayit laapiqoman, veyokal mimmenna mehashshear kezayit echad le"hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza", ukezayit sheni yokal mimmenna bikrika im maror, veyishtayyeru lo shette matztzot shelemot lelechem mishneh lelel b'. Velo yibtza perusa laapiqoman belel b' ad leachar birkat "hammotzi" qodem birkat "al akilat matztza", kede sheyyebarek "hammotzi" al lechem mishneh shelemot, ve"al akilat matztza" yebarek al happerusa, shehapperusa hi "lechem oni", ubah hu yotze yede chobat matztza, velaken yokal mimmenna kezayit echad, ukezayit echad yokal mehashshelema shebberak aleha "hammotzi" kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h, ukezayit shelishi yokal mehashshelema bikrika im maror, velo mehapperusa, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheggam birkat "hammotzi" hi al happerusa, ulepi dibrehem lo naaset adayin shum mitzva bammatztza hashshelema, ulekattechilla yesh laasot bekol matztza mitzva achat kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h, veachar gemar kol hasseuda yokal apiqoman mechatika shepparas ben "hammotzi" le"al akilat matztza":

Veim epshar lo leshayyer perusa qetanna kezayit millel rishon — yeshayyer veyannichenna belel sheni ben shette hashshelemot, shekken tzarik laasot lekattechilla, sheyyihyeh lo lechem mishneh millebad happerusa shemmebarek aleha "al akilat matztza", kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h:

(Vekol zeh kesheen lo raq shalosh matztzot shemurot lishne hallelot, abal im yesh lo od matztza achat sheenah shemura leshem mitzva — yannichenna lelel sheni, ubelel rishon yebarek "hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza", veyibtza kezayit mehashshelema le"hammotzi" ukezayit le"al akilat matztza" mehapperusa shettachteha mittaam shennitbaer besiman ta"h, vehaapiqoman vehakkerika yaaseh gam ken mehapperusa, umah shennishar mehashshelema haelyona im hashshelema hattachtona yanniach lelel sheni im matztza hashshelema sheenah shemura kelal, veyanniach hashshemura millematta vesheenah shemura milmala, ubenehen yanniach happerusa shennishara mehashshelema shel lel rishon leachar shebbatza apiqoman mipperusa zo, vibarek "hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza", veyibtza meat mehaelyona le"hammotzi" ukezayit mehapperusa le"al akilat matztza", vehakkerika yaaseh mehattachtona hashshemura):

Mi sheen lo raq shalosh matztzot shemurot lishne hallelot veen matztza achat maspeqet lo belel rishon lechalleq mimmenna lekol bene beto shelosha kezetim laakilat matztza velikrika velaapiqoman — yipros matztza achat chetzyah laakilat matztza vechetzyah laapiqoman, veachar akilat hammaror yaaseh kerika bachatzi matztza mimmatztzot hashshelemot, veyishtayyeru lo matztza achat umechetza lelel sheni, vibarek "hammotzi" ve"al akilat matztza" al happerusa sheal gabbe hashshelema, vichalleq mimmenna kezayit lekol echad mibbene beto, dekevan shehu sheat haddechaq — yesh lismok al haomerim shebbelel pesach en tzarik lechem mishneh shelemot kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h, umehashshelema yaaseh hakkerika vehaapiqoman:
